individual_sources.name: Carrot
individual_sources.reviewer: Root direct full-native original visual inspection
individual_sources.evaluation: The128px source is a hard orange horizontal wedge with narrow brown transverse marks. Its carrot point reads, but the blocky broad end has no green crown, the contour has small jagged protrusions, and almost flat fill lacks the broad painted form of the newer props. Native detail is already sparse; it cannot support an enlarged high-resolution objective. Actual icon/prop scale and use remain unverified.
individual_sources.refinement: Inventory existing painted carrot/vegetable sources first. Reuse a complete leafy carrot with clean purple or warm-brown contour and two calm painted value bands; otherwise generate only that named small-prop gap. Do not scale this128px wedge up as a quality repair.
